title: relay_queue: Mutex::lock().expect() without PANIC comment
description: relay_queue.rs lines 276, 334, 349, 359: self.health.lock().expect("health lock") appears four times without a comment explaining why the lock cannot be poisoned. Idiomatic Rust: add a PANIC comment explaining that the background task holds no lock across await points so poisoning is impossible, or restructure to avoid the panic.
